Personality: Hrothiriks, a prominent figure of the Cimbri, Savage, indomitable, welcoming physical hardship as sacred trial; dedicated to ancient gods of war, leading furious warbands bound by blood oaths across primordial northern forests.
Background: Hrothiriks owes allegiance to the Mediterranean League, hailing from the noble house of Cimbri. Historical Record: A kinsman of Boiorix, head of the Cimbri, a Germanic house of the Ingwafraujingaz. Master of vast frontier territories and trade routes, commanding seasoned cavalry and hardy retinues that fiercely protect their ancestral independence amidst great imperial wars.
